title: Arkret Federated Device Signing Key Evidence
description: Portable PCR-anchored device-key authorization evidence. A destination independently verifies registration-time DID evidence, the signed PCR genesis receipt, every accepted device authorization hop, and the Seal that covers the target authorization. Current DID resolution is neither required nor accepted as a substitute for historical evidence. Transport-only: this object never enters another Event digest, reducer, Seal, or timeline.

verification_method.description: The registered adapter MUST project the bare-DID portion of this DID URL to actor_id, and the fragment MUST equal device_id. It need not use the current full_id: historical proofs retain their original DID URL after a valid resolution update. The stable actor_id is a did_core_id and MUST NOT be used as a DID URL prefix.

device_signing_key.description: MUST equal the target authorization Event payload device_public_key.

authority_instance.description: MUST reverse-bind actor_id and the principal genesis receipt below. A business relation that supplied an expected authority instance compares all fields byte-for-byte before accepting the device key.

registration_did_evidence.description: Frozen evidence for the registration accepted-at position. A verifier MUST NOT replace it with a current DID Document, current webvh head or current controller key.

principal_genesis_receipt.description: A verified receipt whose scope.kind is pcr_genesis_unit and whose principal/device commitments match the first two authorization_chain Events.

authorization_chain.description: Complete ordered PCR control-state history needed to rederive the target device projection at accepted_seal, starting at root-signed genesis and including every relevant authorize, revoke, reanchor and device-list move. For accepted_device hops the Event proof signer MUST be payload.authorized_by (a current active device), while payload.device_signature proves possession by the new device. range_completeness_evidence proves that reducer inputs were not omitted.

accepted_seal.description: Accepted Seal whose recursively covered control Event set includes every authorization_chain Event digest and whose Realm id equals authority_instance.pcr_realm_id and the realm id committed in principal_genesis_receipt. Verifiers MUST NOT recompute a PCR realm id from the principal DID.

current_device_projection.description: Deterministic projection rederived from authorization_chain at accepted_seal. The outer source assertion is not authority; any mismatch with replayed history fails closed.

range_completeness_evidence.description: Signed ak.attestation.range_completeness Event envelopes whose verified scopes cover the PCR range from genesis through accepted_seal. The verifier checks roots, actor-seq ranges, witnesses required by Realm policy, and rejects gaps or witness disagreement.

control_proof.description: Registration control signature whose transcript digest is committed by the pcr_genesis_unit receipt.
